span.p:
1️⃣ RISOLUZIONE MODELLO
projectSettings.configuredModel → body.model → provider.default_model
→ resolveSupportedModel fallback → claude-sonnet-4.5

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2️⃣ INTENT ESCALATION
LLMPROXY_INTENT_ESCALATION>0 → modelCodingScore + gap vs LLMPROXY_INTENT_ESCALATION_GAP
→ eventuale override a escalationModel

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3️⃣ SELEZIONE PROVIDER
provider esplicito (local) → registry cache (scope) → tokenStore ordinato → default copilot

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4️⃣ SCOPE MATCH
project→project_id · client→client_id · agency→tenant · user→user_id · master:*
rank SCOPE_PRIORITY 4/3/2/1/0

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5️⃣ REORDERING
LLMPROXY_REORDERING={price,power,speed} ogni N minuti → setProviderOrder
(price: cloudprice, power: coding_index, speed: probe latenza)
else ordine manuale llmproxy provider:order

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6️⃣ PROTOCOLLO UPSTREAM
openai-chat Bearer · anthropic-messages x-api-key
· copilot device-flow OAuth · endpoint_variant/proxy/rotation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7️⃣ AUGMENTAZIONE INLINE
metering · inference_info · provider_credit · short_answer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8️⃣ SINK+FORMATO
MODE platform db-layer/event-bus | standalone MongoDB/JSONL
output OpenAI↔Anthropic conversion
